agePrior.explanation: Fay surface-tension spreading to 386 m (the widest third of the slick) takes 2.3-4.7 h for a spreading coefficient of 0.03-0.01 N/m. Real oil spreads faster than Fay alone, so this is a loose ceiling to check the drift age against, not an age.
